opening.argument: The video promotes a flash-loan arbitrage smart contract by presenting it as a way to multiply FTM by more than 400. Its instructions direct viewers to connect MetaMask, deploy the contract, confirm the transaction, and send 98 FTM: “Send FTM to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 98 FTM.” The speaker reinforces that transfer, stating, “I'll make it 98 FTM that I'm gonna send to the contract,” while another instruction suggests sending an additional 100 FMT if the process fails. Although the video presents wallet screens and a stated result, those materials do not independently establish how the contract behaves, where any profit comes from, or whether funds can be recovered. The promised return therefore rests on an unverified contract and requires viewers to transfer funds to it.
